errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such repository, revision, path or record.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle; a name the repository had before, or an owner it moved from with its agreement, finds it under the name it has now.

cursor.description: How many tags the pages before held.

commits.description: Each tag's commit and its checks too, as a page of tags shows them, rather than its name alone.

main.description: A repository's tags that name a commit, the newest commit first and the tags of one commit by name, a page at a time: follow `cursor` until it is absent. No authentication needed; asked as an account, with a service token or the pages' session cookie, a private repository it is a member of is read too, and the answer is that account's alone.

checks.description: The newest run of each workflow at its commit, by the runners the repository names, when `commits` was asked.

commit.description: The commit it names, an annotated tag peeled, when `commits` was asked.
